exhaustive_enums.name: GatewaydError
exhaustive_enums.reason: This enum was already exhaustive in the public API. Keeping it exhaustive preserves downstream matches; future operations that need extensible errors should introduce a new opaque or non-exhaustive error type without changing this contract.

exhaustive_enums.name: RuntimeReadiness
exhaustive_enums.reason: This enum was already exhaustive in the public API. Keeping it exhaustive preserves downstream readiness matches; an extensible successor must be introduced additively.

exhaustive_enums.name: Operation
exhaustive_enums.reason: Every operation that changes the data plane must reach the audit trail; a new operation must fail to compile in each operation log until the log records it.

exhaustive_enums.name: DomainError
exhaustive_enums.reason: This enum was already exhaustive in the public API. Keeping it exhaustive preserves downstream matches; new extensible domain operations should expose a new opaque or non-exhaustive error type.

exhaustive_enums.name: Body
exhaustive_enums.reason: A directive ends with ';', a block, or neither when it is malformed; the syntax has no other form, and the formatter and the language must handle each one.

exhaustive_enums.name: Trivia
exhaustive_enums.reason: Between directives the syntax has only comments and blank lines; the formatter must place every kind, so a new kind is a deliberate breaking change.

exhaustive_enums.name: DiagnosticSeverity
exhaustive_enums.reason: panel-contracts maps every severity onto the protobuf enum. A new severity must fail to compile there rather than be silently reported as an existing one.

exhaustive_enums.name: RouteMatcher
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-grpc encodes every matcher onto the wire. A new matcher must fail to compile there rather than make a route silently unserialisable.

exhaustive_enums.name: RouteAction
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-grpc encodes every action onto the wire. A new action must fail to compile there rather than make a route silently unserialisable.

exhaustive_enums.name: LoadBalancingPolicy
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-grpc encodes every policy onto the wire, and gateway-pingora maps it onto a Pingora selector. A new policy must fail to compile in both rather than fall back to an unintended one.

exhaustive_enums.name: AccessLogFormat
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-proto-codec maps every access log format onto the protobuf enum. A new format must fail to compile there rather than be sent as the enclosing scope's format.

exhaustive_enums.name: WwwRedirect
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-proto-codec maps every redirect mode onto the protobuf enum. A new mode must fail to compile there rather than be sent as no redirect.

exhaustive_enums.name: HealthCheckProtocol
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-proto-codec encodes every probe protocol onto the wire, and gateway-pingora builds a probe for each. A new protocol must fail to compile in both rather than probe the wrong way.

exhaustive_enums.name: AlertChannelKind
exhaustive_enums.reason: A channel's kind decides where notifications go; a new kind must fail to compile until every adapter sends it, rather than being sent as a webhook.

exhaustive_enums.name: AlertComparison
exhaustive_enums.reason: A rule's comparison decides when it fires; an adapter must never map an unknown comparison to another one, so a new comparison must fail to compile until every adapter handles it.

exhaustive_enums.name: AlertMeasure
exhaustive_enums.reason: Each measure is a fixed query in observability-service and a field of the alerts contract; a new measure must fail to compile in every adapter until it maps the measure, rather than reading as another one.

exhaustive_enums.name: AlertSeverity
exhaustive_enums.reason: Severity travels to receivers as a notification label; a new severity must fail to compile until every adapter carries it, rather than reaching receivers as another severity.

exhaustive_enums.name: AgentCapability
exhaustive_enums.reason: The console offers a host action only for a capability the agent reports; a new capability must fail to compile in every adapter until it is mapped, rather than being shown as another one.

exhaustive_enums.name: CapabilityState
exhaustive_enums.reason: A capability's state decides whether its actions are offered; a new state must fail to compile until every adapter maps it, rather than reading as available.

exhaustive_enums.name: DirectoryKind
exhaustive_enums.reason: Each kind is a directory the agent's configuration names; a new kind must fail to compile until every adapter labels it, rather than being reported as another directory.

exhaustive_enums.name: GatewayServiceAction
exhaustive_enums.reason: Each action is something the engine does to the gateway's container and an audit event of its own; a new action must fail to compile in every adapter until it maps it, rather than doing something else to the gateway.

exhaustive_enums.name: ContainerState
exhaustive_enums.reason: A container's state decides which actions the console offers and how a filter matches; a new state must fail to compile in every adapter until it is mapped, and states this build does not know arrive as Unknown.

exhaustive_enums.name: ContainerAction
exhaustive_enums.reason: Each action is a call on the engine and an audit event of its own; a new action must fail to compile in every adapter until it maps it, rather than doing something else.

exhaustive_enums.name: ContainerLogStream
exhaustive_enums.reason: Which output a line came from decides where the command line writes it and how the console marks it; a new output must fail to compile in every adapter until it is mapped, rather than being shown as another one.

exhaustive_enums.name: ContainerLogStart
exhaustive_enums.reason: Where following starts decides which lines a client receives; a new start must fail to compile in every adapter until it maps it, rather than following from somewhere else.

exhaustive_enums.name: PruneKind
exhaustive_enums.reason: Each kind is a different removal on the engine and a line of the audit trail; a new kind must fail to compile in every adapter until it removes it, rather than being removed as another kind.

exhaustive_enums.name: ComposeAction
exhaustive_enums.reason: Each action is a set of calls on the engine and an audit event of its own; a new action must fail to compile in every adapter until it maps it, rather than doing something else to a project.

exhaustive_enums.name: ImagePullEvent
exhaustive_enums.reason: A pull reports progress and then what it pulled; the audit records a pull when it ends, so a new kind of event must fail to compile wherever pulls are relayed and recorded, rather than ending one unrecorded.

exhaustive_enums.name: RouteCondition
exhaustive_enums.reason: Compiling to the IR, validating and printing in the configuration language handle each condition; a new kind must fail to compile there rather than being dropped from a route or its files.

exhaustive_enums.name: ValueTest
exhaustive_enums.reason: Compiling to the IR and printing in the configuration language handle each test; a new test must fail to compile there rather than being dropped.

exhaustive_enums.name: RouteCondition
exhaustive_enums.reason: Every codec, validator and evaluator of route conditions must handle each kind; a new kind must fail to compile where conditions are encoded or evaluated, rather than being dropped and widening what a route takes.

exhaustive_enums.name: ValueTest
exhaustive_enums.reason: Every codec and evaluator of route conditions must handle each test; a new test must fail to compile where tests are encoded or evaluated, rather than being dropped.

exhaustive_enums.name: BackupChange
exhaustive_enums.reason: Each change of the backups is an audit event of its own; a new kind of change must fail to compile where changes are recorded, rather than going unrecorded.

exhaustive_enums.name: SiteFileChange
exhaustive_enums.reason: Each change of the sites' files is an audit event of its own; a new kind of change must fail to compile where changes are recorded, rather than going unrecorded.

exhaustive_enums.name: ConfigurationQuery
exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the configuration API contract. The configuration service and its callers match it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile wherever it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.name: ModelQuery
exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the configuration API contract. The configuration service and its callers match it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile wherever it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the configuration API contract. The configuration service and its callers match it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile wherever it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the configuration API contract. The configuration service and its callers match it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile wherever it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the configuration API contract. The configuration service and its callers match it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile wherever it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.name: ConfigurationCommand
exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the configuration API contract. The configuration service and its callers match it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile wherever it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.name: ModelChange
exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the configuration API contract. The configuration service and its callers match it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile wherever it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.name: LanguageChange
exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the configuration API contract. The configuration service and its callers match it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile wherever it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.name: RevisionChange
exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the configuration API contract. The configuration service and its callers match it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile wherever it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.name: ApprovalChange
exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the configuration API contract. The configuration service and its callers match it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile wherever it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.name: DiffBase
exhaustive_enums.reason: What a revision is compared with. The configuration service resolves each base explicitly, so a new base must fail to compile where it is not resolved yet.

exhaustive_enums.name: Gate
exhaustive_enums.reason: What the approvals say about applying a change. Applying matches every outcome, so a new one must fail to compile there instead of letting a change through or holding it by default.

exhaustive_enums.name: CertificateQuery
exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the certificate API contract. The certificate service matches it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile where it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.name: CertificateCommand
exhaustive_enums.reason: An operation of the certificate API contract. The certificate service matches it exhaustively, so a new operation must fail to compile where it is not handled yet instead of reaching a wildcard.

exhaustive_enums.name: Challenge
exhaustive_enums.reason: The ACME challenges an automatic certificate can use. The service maps each onto its ACME client's, so a new one must fail to compile where it is not mapped yet.

exhaustive_enums.name: DnsProviderKind
exhaustive_enums.reason: The DNS providers the service can build. Each maps onto a provider implementation, so a new kind must fail to compile where none is built for it yet.

exhaustive_enums.name: TsigAlgorithm
exhaustive_enums.reason: The TSIG algorithms (RFC 8945) a provider signs updates with. Each maps onto the DNS client's, so a new one must fail to compile where it is not mapped yet.
